verdict.rationale: Skills are plain markdown (`skills/*/SKILL.md`) and the porting guide says everything in `skills/` is shared verbatim by every harness, with porting never touching SKILL.md files (docs-13, docs-37). A hands-on probe copied a skill folder into `.claude/skills/` via `npx skills add --copy`, and its SKILL.md frontmatter read back cleanly. Cross-runtime paths like `~/.agents/skills/` and a long list of supported harnesses back portability (docs-31, gh-19). Missing for 10: full auto-trigger behavior in a new harness still needs a per-harness bootstrap injector and tool-mapping reference plus a separate install per harness (docs-28, gh-5), and no hands-on test of moving a skill from one harness to another.
